rationale: I reviewed the frozen PATH-S06 protocol, baseline gate, saved candidate, prior decisions, and registered extension result. The vulnerable baseline established the control by disclosing the outside-file marker through an in-root symbolic link. Traversal 03 then returned HTTP 200 and disclosed the same marker because its lexical path containment check did not verify the filesystem target followed by fs.readFile. I record FOLLOW_UP_REJECT_CANDIDATE for the bounded benchmark because the registered symbolic-link traversal remains exploitable. The earlier request-more-testing record and three supplemental robustness failures remain preserved; this later qualification does not overwrite primary-v1 or supplemental-v1.
